column1: # Garage Gadget partition table — 16 MB flash.
# Two 3 MB app slots give room for OTA. The `history` partition is the
# on-device event log: a 1 MB ring of 16-byte records
# At a busy 100 events/day that is well over a year of retention
# why the firmware can promise "last 10 days" without ever touching NVS.
# NVS stays at the stock offset and size — it only holds settings (~2 KB)
# and keeping it standard means the bootloader and OTA behave normally.
